steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 35
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: That word is only used in one regional dialect.

The old town is a protected cultural heritage site.
